# Steady Paws

> Steady Paws sells a 28-day home exercise plan for senior dogs and cats: an interactive PDF with 11 gentle, equipment-free exercises (8 for dogs, 3 for cats), a 20-second video demo for each, a traffic-light safety check, and a 28-day tracker with a before-and-after mobility score. Price EUR 14, instant download, 30-day money-back guarantee. Made in Greystones, Ireland. Not veterinary advice; owners should check with their vet first.

## Key pages
- [28-Day Senior Mobility Plan](https://steadypaw.enterprises/): what's inside, price, FAQ
- [Video demos](https://steadypaw.enterprises/videos): 20-second demos of all 11 exercises
- [About](https://steadypaw.enterprises/about): who makes it and the veterinary sources it's based on

## Exercises
- [Gentle Exercises for Senior Dogs and Cats](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises): all 11 exercises
- [Bicycle Legs](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/bicycle-legs): Dogs who are stiff after lying down, or too sore for standing exercises.
- [Cookie Stretches](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/cookie-stretches): Dogs with a stiff back or neck, or who struggle to turn round or curl up.
- [Sit-to-Stand](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/sit-to-stand): Dogs who struggle to get up, push up with their front legs, or have weak or wobbly back legs.
- [Down-to-Sit](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/down-to-sit): Dogs who find getting up from lying down hard work.
- [Weight Shifts](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/weight-shifts): Dogs whose back legs slip on floors or who look wobbly standing still.
- [Broomstick Poles](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/broomstick-poles): Dogs who scuff their back paws, trip on steps, or have lost coordination.
- [Figure-of-Eight Walks](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/figure-of-eight): Dogs who walk stiffly or seem to turn more easily one way than the other.
- [Cushion Stand](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/cushion-stand): Dogs who are a bit wobbly but steady enough to stand on a soft surface.
- [Slow-Mo Wand Play](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/cat-wand-play): Senior cats who have slowed down or play less than they used to.
- [Step-Up Staircase](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/cat-step-up-staircase): Cats who have stopped jumping onto the bed, sofa or windowsill, or hesitate before they jump.
- [Treat Trail & Reach](https://steadypaw.enterprises/exercises/cat-treat-trail): Older cats who sleep most of the day and move very little.
